Speed Measurement

Precision speed enforcement, intelligent traffic analytics, and multi-target radar-video fusion for highways and urban roadways.

Traffic Speed Measurement Solution

What we offer

Coloron's Speed Measurement Solution boasts high accuracy and low detection deviation. It excels in scenarios on both high- and low-speed roads. It can effectively regulate driver behavior, reduce traffic accidents caused by driving too fast or too slow, and elevate road safety. Over all, Coloron’s solution improves the efficiency of road safety management for governments, enterprises, and users in general.
